title: Embedded Systems R&D Engineer
summary: Full-time embedded systems R&D at Lockheed Martin Advanced Technology Laboratories, Spectrum Systems, in the Twin Cities, MN.

cover.alt: White ATL lettering on black above a row of colored bars

sections.heading: Role
paragraphs: Embedded systems research and development engineer at Lockheed Martin Advanced Technology Laboratories, Spectrum Systems, based in the Twin Cities, MN. I joined full time in July 2026, in the same lab where I interned.

I design FPGA logic in VHDL, with simulation and verification, including high-speed data packetizers, an I2C physical interface, and an EEPROM interface. I write low-level instrument-control software in C++, C, and Python, and prepare customer-facing interface control documents.

My work also includes testing and checkout of complex optical and photonic integrated circuits, hypersonic impact analysis of proprietary space-grade materials, and signal processing and machine-learning neural-network models for audio steganography.
